outcome: Frequency of isthmocele detection by ultrasound
Symptoms associated with isthmocele formation (scar pain, lower abdominal pain, etc.)
cohort: 329 women who gave birth by cesarean section
finding: The study found a 44.4% prevalence of isthmoceles 6 months after cesarean section and that women with isthmoceles experienced more intense scar pain and lower abdominal pain.
